propositions: Read-only derivations compute llm_call_proxy, latency, cost_per_accepted_change, first_pass_verification, and env_diagnosis_interval from existing gate sidecars using raw ordered scans of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files
llm_calls and latency metrics are summed only from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics blocks; COMPLETION_VERDICT carries no metrics and is never used for cost computation
cost_per_accepted_change is summed llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records; returns None when zero accepted closes exist
first_pass_verification is the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest-first by filename) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1
env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record for the same gate (matched on ERROR.gate field); unclosed intervals have no following same-gate PASS
All metrics register as source=sidecar with high confidence; no data is written, only read
